about: Every location outside the live engine that holds per record content for the 379 records tools/records.js counts, found by a sweep of every branch of MOB (353 remote refs) and reboot-os (85) on 31 October 2026. Read by node tools/records.js --sweep, which pulls each file straight out of git (git show ref:path), maps its fields onto the depth record shape by meaning, and scores it with the same strict checker as a draft. So the question 'is it already written somewhere' is a run, not a search.

Add a location here when you find one, with the ref that holds it and the adapter that reads it. A location that no longer resolves is reported by name, never skipped quietly. Nothing here is canon: content is canon only in atuned_src/engine, and approved only with the owner's name and date.

Found and NOT listed, with the reason. reboot-os atuned/data/psyche_node_descriptive_templates.json and psyche_entity_descriptive_templates.json (branch docs/psyche-hierarchy-end-to-end-tdd-2026-10-19): 112 node and 73 entity shells whose interpretation text is null on every record, by their own counts. reboot-os lookdev/handoff/COMPLEX_RECORDS_RESEARCH_PILOT_BATCH1..4_2026-10-29.md (main): real drafted research for the 23 complexes of reboot-os canon.json, a taxonomy the MOB engine does not hold as records, so it maps onto none of the 379; it is the best existing source for the audit's open complex record question. MOB docs/data/ATUNED_DEEP_PSYCHOLOGICAL_RECORD_REGISTRY_v1.json (main): 147 records keyed by its own taxonomy, the source the 33 and 108 registries below were generated from.
